name: streak
title: Streak
description: A player's run of days: the count, a line on where today stands, and a strip of recent days, each marked played, rested, missed or still open. Rest days come from a `RestRule` (weekdays and dates that never break a run), so a habit does not punish a day…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/streak

Installed to `components/ui/games/streak.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/streak';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/streak

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
